<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="bpmnReleaseApproval_definitions" targetNamespace="https://aisep.example/model/workbench/" exporter="AISEP tools/aisep.py diagram">
  <bpmn:process id="bpmnReleaseApproval" name="批准或驳回发布并打 release 标签" isExecutable="false" processType="Private">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="bpmnRelStart" name="准备发布">
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelStart-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelPrepare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="bpmnRelOpened" name="批准专用 PR 已开出">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelPublish-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelOpened</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="bpmnRelStale" name="提示重新准备分支">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelStaleGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelStale</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="bpmnRelStopped" name="停下由人处理，什么都不推">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelCheckGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelStopped</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="bpmnRelDecide" name="Albert 批准（gate 通过时）或驳回发布">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelStaleGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelDecide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelDecide-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelCheckGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="bpmnRelOpenGate" name="Albert 在关口页打开发布批准分支">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelPrepare-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelOpenGate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelOpenGate-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelStaleGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="bpmnRelPrepare" name="会话脚本：从 origin/main 最新提交拉发布批准分支">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelStart-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelPrepare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelPrepare-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelOpenGate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="bpmnRelPublish" name="会话脚本：推送并开批准专用 PR">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelDecisionGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelPublish</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelTag-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelPublish</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelPublish-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelOpened</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="bpmnRelTag" name="会话脚本：打 release 标签">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelDecisionGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelTag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelTag-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelPublish</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="bpmnRelCheckGateway" name="会话脚本核对记录与合并时校验通过、且标签不冲突吗？" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelDecide-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelCheckGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelCheckGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelDecisionGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelCheckGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelStopped</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="bpmnRelDecisionGateway" name="结论是批准吗？" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelCheckGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelDecisionGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelDecisionGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelPublish</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelDecisionGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelTag</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="bpmnRelStaleGateway" name="分支基于的提交还是 origin/main 最新提交吗？" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>rel-bpmnRelOpenGate-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelStaleGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelStaleGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelDecide</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>rel-bpmnRelStaleGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelStale</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelCheckGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelDecisionGateway" name="通过" sourceRef="bpmnRelCheckGateway" targetRef="bpmnRelDecisionGateway" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelCheckGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelStopped" name="不通过或标签冲突" sourceRef="bpmnRelCheckGateway" targetRef="bpmnRelStopped" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelDecide-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelCheckGateway" sourceRef="bpmnRelDecide" targetRef="bpmnRelCheckGateway" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelDecisionGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelPublish" name="驳回" sourceRef="bpmnRelDecisionGateway" targetRef="bpmnRelPublish" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelDecisionGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelTag" name="批准" sourceRef="bpmnRelDecisionGateway" targetRef="bpmnRelTag" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelOpenGate-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelStaleGateway" sourceRef="bpmnRelOpenGate" targetRef="bpmnRelStaleGateway" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelPrepare-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelOpenGate" sourceRef="bpmnRelPrepare" targetRef="bpmnRelOpenGate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelPublish-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelOpened" sourceRef="bpmnRelPublish" targetRef="bpmnRelOpened" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelStaleGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelDecide" name="仍是最新" sourceRef="bpmnRelStaleGateway" targetRef="bpmnRelDecide" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelStaleGateway-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelStale" name="已前进" sourceRef="bpmnRelStaleGateway" targetRef="bpmnRelStale" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelStart-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelPrepare" sourceRef="bpmnRelStart" targetRef="bpmnRelPrepare" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="rel-bpmnRelTag-sequenceFlow-bpmnRelPublish" sourceRef="bpmnRelTag" targetRef="bpmnRelPublish" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="bpmnReleaseApproval_diagram">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="bpmnReleaseApproval_plane" bpmnElement="bpmnReleaseApproval">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="bpmnRelStart_di" bpmnElement="bpmnRelStart">
